story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,876, a gap-up of 0.22% from the previous close of 25,819.
The index dipped to a low of 25,734 (-0.33%) around 9:45 AM and touched a high of 25,975 (+0.60%) around 10:55 AM.
It settled at 25,884 (+0.25%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
21 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 28 declined; Bank Nifty lagged (-0.26%).
Latest institutional data (25 Nov): FII/FPI net +4479 Cr, DII net +4019 Cr.
risks: Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,182.78 (-0.25%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$90.25 (-4.61%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 92.540 (-0.29%), US 10-year yield 4.85% (-1.14%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 26,038.5 (+0.59% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
